title: After the Japanese Derby: Bonding over Mutual Losses

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer and Ines Fujin both burn out and end up losing the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite their loss, they compliment each other, and a tenuous friendship starts to grow between them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night, after reviewing the day's race, Daitaku Helios seems to have come up with some kind of "god-tier" race plan.
